people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: When Jesus saw her, he called her, and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”
translations.bsb: When Jesus saw her, He called her over and said, “Woman, you are set free from your disability.”
translations.kjv: And when Jesus saw her, he called her to him, and said unto her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.
